environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; pearlescent and iridescent textures; plates have a smooth, porcelain-like finish; rounded edges on the microscopic geometry to ensure a 'soft-touch' appeal.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant layout: Top-Left: the full spherical organism; Top-Right: a hero shot of a single intricate calcite plate; Bottom-Left: a cluster of plates settling into grey marl; Bottom-Right: a wide shot of the milky-white water surface.
visual_logic.ground: Soft, fine-grained white chalk dust, providing a bright and clean educational background.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, even diffused light to highlight the interlocking patterns of the calcite shields.
